name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix + battle core-table data_fd2_battle_*; reflects domain (summon anim variant C, 5 ring slots), data type (array), and role (per-slot computed x-coordinate). The 'c' is a summon-animation variant letter and '5slot' is the array dimension -- both semantic, not Ghidra address residue. Matches sibling naming (_y_coord_array, _frame_counter_array, _blit_counter_array). Ghidra symbol is byte-identical.
purpose: Per-slot computed x-coordinate (cos-based ring placement) for the variant-C 5-slot radial summon-spell animation.
logic_summary: int[5], one entry per of the 5 ring slots. The radial-blit phase (state_code 1/2/7/8) recomputes each frame: x_coord[i] = round(sweep + angle_accumulator * cos(i*0x48 deg)), sweep = 0x1E (player/ally) or 0x5A (enemy). state_code 3 (one-shot, latched) swaps slots [2] and [4]. The value is then read in the blit phases to position the sprite (x_coord[i] added into the dst offset together with y_coord[i]*row_stride + origin_y). Written before any read each animation run -> zero-bss runtime scratch.
element_semantics: Signed 32-bit horizontal pixel offset (relative to origin) for one ring slot; one of 5 slots. May be negative (cos covers the full ring); used signed in dst-offset arithmetic.
